study: Forecasting Temperature in Ghana Using a Hybrid ARIMA-LSTM Model Enhanced by a Seasonal Variance Adaptive Optimizer

diagnostic.status: EXPLORATORY — not pre-registered; Module 3's verdict stands

module4_recombination.compromise: Validation-period residuals are in-sample, extracted from a model fitted on training plus validation. No future data is used, but the residuals are fitted rather than predicted.

ablations.B_note: The notebook 09 version was invalid: Adam largely cancels a constant loss multiplier, so the test could not detect the effect. Reworked here across both optimisers.

headline.svao_effect: no significant effect on validation or test
headline.hybridisation: no benefit over the standalone LSTM under either coupling
headline.arima_order: per-station orders beat uniform (1,1,1) at all stations
